description: ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: port and maritime datasets (zone alea) is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 57 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about port and maritime; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file.
